description: This article was originally published by Front Porch Republic on November 2, 2022.Shelby County, IN. The main east-west thoroughfare in Shelby County, Indiana is IN-44. It’s a quintessential Hoosier state road. That is, it’s a two-lane means to an interstate end. Since 44 intersects both I-65 and I-74, it serves as a sort of rural bypass of Indianapolis.
